### Bio:

I am a second-year MS student in the Department of Biostatistics at UCLA. I previously completed my undergraduate studies in Statistics at the University of British Columbia. My research focuses on developing statistical methods for functional and longitudinal data, with interests in modeling heterogeneity and latent structure in biomedical studies. My work includes functional EEG analysis in autism, treatment response in cardiovascular studies, and longitudinal mental health trajectories. In my free time, I enjoy regular cardio workouts, reading and listening to classical music.
